**Best move:** Nxe6+

**Main line:** Nxe6+ Kh8 (or Kg8) Nxc7 - White wins the queen.

**Explanation (coaching note):**

Always scan for pieces that can be hit twice simultaneously by one move, especially when the opponent has recently moved their queen away from defenders.
